summary.text: Jamie Jeffery is the Democratic candidate for the Colorado State Senate, District 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been an educator for 31 years and serves as Mayor of Lochbuie, Colorado.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jeffery's profession as dean and her education as a bachelor's degree from Boise State University in 1995 and graduate degrees from the University of Idaho in 2001 and 2006.
She advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary.
In her survey, she identified mental health, education, equity, human rights, health insurance and access to affordable housing and food as the policy areas she cares most about.
